description: Source code for managing the DHCPv6-in-IPv6 tunnel service 'service_dslite', including start, stop, restart, and configuration functions, with DNS resolution and system configuration handling.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the command-line interface.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments and executes corresponding commands.

methods.name: serv_dslite_init
methods.description: Initializes the service, opens sys events, and sets the WAN mode.

methods.name: serv_dslite_term
methods.description: Cleans up resources and closes sys events.

methods.name: dslite_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6-in-IPv6 tunnel service, configures routing, DNS, firewall rules, and system parameters.

methods.name: dslite_stop
methods.description: Stops the tunnel service, restores system settings, and cleans up.

methods.name: dslite_restart
methods.description: Restarts the service by stopping and then starting it again.

methods.name: dslite_clear_status
methods.description: Clears the stored status and configuration related to the tunnel.
